Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:84431
Court No. - 68
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 18205 of 2024
Applicant :- Brijesh Yadav

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mo. Saif,Qaisar Kamal Ansari,Shamsun Nisha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material
brought on record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 32/2024,
under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, police station - Bankata, District -
Deoria with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is cousin of the husband of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with cousin of applicant has taken place on 17.04.2022.

It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against the applicant Brijesh Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100954953/
1 and co-accused persons and that no specific role has been assigned to the applicant.

entities.text: Brijesh Yadav vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on the body of deceased and cause of death has been shown as ante-mortem hanging.
It was further submitted that being cousin of the husband of deceased, applicant was not going to be benefited from fulfillment of demand of dowry.

Co-accused Pappu Yadav, who is also cousin of the husband of deceased, has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 30.04.2024, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15710 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15710 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 06.03.2024, having no criminal history, and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant - Brijesh Yadav involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 10.5.2024 S Rawat  Brijesh Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100954953/
